# owner=user ruling — env_0080 (coordinator, binding on instantiators and policy auditors)

A gold call to an `owner=user` task tool is legitimate only when it is one of:
(a) a transition the charter marks as the customer's own decision (by: user) — e.g. a membership cancellation / immediate cancellation / trial cancellation / auto-renew resume, a card account closure or credit-balance refund request, a plan cancellation, a return the customer initiates — recorded as the customer's request and confirmed by the customer, together with its same-category consequence the base policy groups with it;
(b) a holder-completed secure payment (PCI: staff never take card numbers; the payment method is not on file, which the policy's own rule and the persona both make visible);
(c) the holder's own payment/deposit applied to their own account.
A label-only "the customer places the order" with nothing the customer decides or completes is rejected.
